comments.body:
I have enough context. I’m going to answer this as a distillation, with one caveat up front: the old issue has a claimed implementation comment, but the current code path still needs the changes.I checked #396 and current `main`.

Key context to keep:

- #396 already identified the right shape: support `/review` on issues as a **focused default-branch review**, while preserving existing PR diff review behavior.
- Important user requirement from #396: the triggering inline message must be passed through as `request_text` so the issue review has a clear goal/scope.
- Caveat: #396 has a Sepo comment saying this was implemented, but current `main` still looks PR-only, so treat #396 as design context, not landed code.

Current PR-only gates:

- Dispatch prompt says `review` is only valid for PRs: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/prompts/agent-dispatch.md#L10-L15
- `applyDispatchPolicy` rejects issue review: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/triage.ts#L495-L503
- Router only dispatches review when `target_kind == 'pull_request'`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L1134-L1145
- `agent-review.yml` still requires `pr_number` and hardcodes `target_kind: pull_request`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-review.yml#L3-L42 and https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-review.yml#L220-L227
- Review prompt is still `gh pr diff` centered: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/prompts/review.md#L3-L12

Recommended implementation distilled from #396:

1. Allow `review` for `issue` and `pull_request` in triage/policy; keep discussions unsupported.
2. Update `agent-router.yml` to dispatch review for issues too, passing `target_kind`, `target_number`, `request_text`, and source comment metadata.
3. Refactor `agent-review.yml` to be target-aware:
   - PR mode: keep current PR diff/head/inline/synthesis behavior.
   - Issue mode: review default branch, use the issue body/comments plus `request_text` as scope, skip PR-only head capture, PR inline comments, and PR-only rubric review behavior unless separately generalized.
4. Split or branch review prompts:
   - PR review uses `gh pr view` / `gh pr diff`.
   - Issue review uses `gh issue view`, repo inspection, and explicitly refuses broad whole-repo audit when scope is missing.
5. Post issue-mode synthesis back to the issue, not as a PR review/comment.
6. Add tests for explicit `/review` on issue, `agent/review` label on issue, unchanged PR review routing, and issue-mode no PR-only operations.

The most important acceptance criterion: issue `/review` should never silently become “review all of main.” It should require or infer a focused goal from the issue/comment text.
